```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  dpi = 200
)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r load-and-clean}
df_raw <- read_csv("data/college_scorecard/college_scorecard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

df <- df_raw |>
  # Fix typos and misleading names in the raw data
  rename(
    predominantly_black_institution = predominetly_black_institution,
    loan_default_rate_3yr           = load_default_rate_3yr,
    share_white                     = n_students_white,
    share_black                     = n_students_black,
    share_hispanic                  = n_students_hispanic,
    share_asian                     = n_students_asian,
    share_native                    = n_students_native
  ) |>
  # Fix columns that were read in as character
  mutate(
    share_low_income          = as.numeric(share_low_income),
    median_earnings_10yr_after = as.numeric(median_earnings_10yr_after),
    online_only = if_else(online_only %in% c(1, "1", "Online only"), 1, 0),
    ownership = factor(ownership),
    state     = factor(state),
    region    = factor(region)
  )
```

```{r missingness-report}
#| echo: false

outcome_vars <- c(
  "completion_rate",
  "median_earnings_10yr_after",
  "avg_cost_attendance",
  "loan_default_rate_3yr"
)

n_total   <- nrow(df)
n_online  <- sum(df$online_only == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_hbcu    <- sum(df$hbcu == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pbi     <- sum(df$predominantly_black_institution == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

missingness <- tibble(
  Variable = outcome_vars,
  N_missing = sapply(outcome_vars, \(v) sum(is.na(df[[v]]))),
  Pct_missing = sapply(outcome_vars, \(v) mean(is.na(df[[v]])) * 100),
  N_missing_HBCU = sapply(outcome_vars, \(v) sum(is.na(df[[v]][df$hbcu == 1]))),
  N_missing_PBI  = sapply(outcome_vars, \(v) sum(is.na(df[[v]][df$predominantly_black_institution == 1])))
)
```

**Full dataset (before any restrictions):** `r n_total` institutions — including `r n_online` online-only, `r n_hbcu` HBCUs, and `r n_pbi` PBIs.

```{r missingness-table}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  missingness,
  digits = 1,
  col.names = c("Variable", "N missing", "% missing", "Missing (HBCU)", "Missing (PBI)"),
  caption   = "Missingness in main outcome variables before sample restrictions"
)
```

```{r sample-restrictions}
df <- df |>
  filter(online_only != 1)

# Derived variables
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    hbcu_or_pbi   = as.integer(hbcu == 1 | predominantly_black_institution == 1),
    share_nonwhite = share_black + share_hispanic + share_asian + share_native
  )
```

**After dropping online-only schools:** `r nrow(df)` institutions remain (`r n_total - nrow(df)` dropped).
